## Crichton et al. (2016), bcc V thermal BM3

**untested** (not refittable) · `vanadium_bcc_crichton_2016_bm3_thermal` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/vanadium_bcc.md#record-vanadium_bcc_crichton_2016_bm3_thermal)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Only a temperature-binned subset is plotted. The exact 62 P-V-T observations, their errors, and simultaneous NaCl/Au lattice readings were not recovered. A 29-point nominal-temperature proxy fit is diagnostic only; the 24 digitized curve checkpoints independently test the published parameterization.

- Full final typeset article and any inaccessible supplement could not be verified.
- Exact NaCl/Au calibration versions are unspecified in the accessible methods.
- The Conclusion expansion percentages disagree with the explicit coefficients; the latter match the independent plotted isotherms.
- Original row-wise temperatures and covariance are absent.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** vanadium\_crichton\_2016\_figure2\_points
- **Observations:** 29
